title: Placement release path reads a stale app.press on the tray-chip arming click
detail: The click that arms placement from a chip is not a placement click, yet its release enters the placement-commit path against a stale press (a prior map press, or {0,0} at app start). Commit always re-validates through topology_apply_edit, so no unvalidated mutation is possible — impact is a no-op or a min-separation-rejected attempt at the tile under the tray. Story 3.5 specifies 'click the map to drop'; this is off-spec state handling.
recommended_fix: Invalidate the press when a chip arms placement (set app.press to a sentinel such as {-1,-1}), or add a press_valid flag so only a map press enables the release-time commit.
